description: Rewrite Godot 3 GDScript to Godot 4 where that is mechanical: @export/@onready/@tool, renamed classes, functions, properties and constants, yield() to await, connect()/emit_signal() to signals, funcref() to callables, members that moved (OS.get_ticks_msec() to Time). Strings, comments and node paths are left alone. Without `write` it only reports the changes; with `write: true` it rewrites the scripts. It also lists what still needs a hand (setget, move_and_slide arguments, rpc keywords, export hints it does not know). Scenes and project settings are not migrated; Godot's --convert-3to4 does those. `files` limits it to some res:// scripts; `detail` brief shows up to 12 changes per file, full shows every change. Running it twice changes nothing more. Use it before fixing Godot 3 findings from godot_review one by one, and run godot_review afterwards.

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

write.description: rewrite the scripts on disk (default false: report only)

name: godot_migrate
title: Port Godot 3 scripts to Godot 4
